page.overview:
Who is Batora Kuromori?

A former shinobi, Bataro was later taken in by the king, giving him a new life in the Land of Bamboo.

He is quite dutiful, even complying with Kae's more childish requests, understanding them as a way of Kae reclaiming lost experiences due to her station. He is also quite a responsible person who followed the movement of people in the kitchen, remembering every moment. His desire to protect and help Kae stems from a deep sense of gratitude to her father for giving him a new life in the Land of Bamboo. Aside from his loyalty to her father, Batora is also quite attached to Kae herself, inquiring about her condition after her studies and rejoicing that she was able to make a friend and seeing how hard she works on her goals.

Batora is a lean man with short brown hair and cloven eyebrows, as well as grey eyes, under which he has noticeable long lines. He wears a grey suit, and brown boots. When inside the house, he wears blue slippers.

Batora is a retired shinobi, he remains strong enough to carry a heavy stone statue of the Third Hokage without getting out of breath, and remains skilled in Water Release. Since retiring, he has become weaker to physical assaults, passing out when Kawaki crashed into his groin. As Kae's caretaker, he is implied to be a skilled homemaker, tending to her needs. He is implied to be a skilled baker, offering to make her a cake. In order to better serve her outside their accommodations, he has memorised the location of various relevant locations, such as her friends homes. Likewise, he is a very skilled investigator, having gathered enough evidence to discover the mastermind behind an assassination plot.
